description: agent-harness contract v2 has two validation gaps. (1) validate_request accepts a version 2 request that lists the "qualified_isolation" capability with "limits": null; a qualified launch must always carry explicit limits, so such a request must raise ContractError. Requests without qualified_isolation may still omit limits. (2) validate_result must accept result.limits.applied only if it has exactly the requested limit keys plus timeout_seconds, each an integer (not a bool or float) equal to the requested value; anything else must raise ContractError. Change src/agent_harness/contract.py only.
environment: Python >= 3.13 stdlib; base tree = agent-harness f2eeda2 without .github, no repository history
visible_checks: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.test_contract tests.test_contract_v2 tests.test_boundaries (from the workspace root)
provenance: real fix: agent-harness commit b29dfdf8977e6f5bce2011a502016ffffcc6744b (fix(contract): exact applied limits, explicit limits for qualified requests, backend targets, 2026-10-07), base = its parent f2eeda2; reference/good.patch is that commit's contract.py diff (its execution.py backend-target change is out of scope); hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark from the commit's tests (2026-10-11).
